title: Total time correct
description: Essential: The final answer for total falling time must be 5 seconds.

title: Final displacement correct
description: Essential: The final answer for displacement in the last 2 seconds must be 80 meters.

title: Equation for total displacement
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the kinematic equation h = (1/2)gt² for the entire fall.

title: Equation for displacement before final second
description: Important: The solution must set up the relation for the displacement up to (t-1) seconds using the given fraction (9/25 of total).

title: Solves for time algebraically
description: Important: The solution must correctly solve the simultaneous equations to find the total time t.

title: Calculates displacement for last 2s
description: Important: The solution must correctly find the displacement in the last 2 seconds by subtracting the displacement in the first 3 seconds from the total.

title: Uses correct g value
description: Optional: The solution explicitly uses g = 10 m/s² in all calculations.

title: Misinterprets final second fraction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly setting up the equation for the displacement in the final second (e.g., using it as 9/25 of the remaining distance).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Omitting units in the final answer or using an incorrect unit for displacement or time.
